meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 读取 screenpipe 记录的屏幕历史,找出重复工作模式,与仓库已有技能比对,为未覆盖的模式起草新技能说明或组合方案,生成提案报告供审阅;检测在本机进行,仅脱敏摘要发给语言模型。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近 4 小时、一天或一周的工作并提出新技能,或要求找出未被覆盖的工作流、起草新技能时触发。需要本机 screenpipe 正在运行,否则技能拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我最近 4 小时的工作,提议可以自动化成技能的部分。
say.note: 技能会读取本地屏幕历史并生成提案。

say.text: 看看我这周重复做的研究流程,哪些还没有技能覆盖?
say.note: 会与仓库中已有技能比对,列出缺口。

say.text: 根据我最近的文献检索习惯,起草一个新技能草稿。
say.note: 会生成 SKILL.md 草稿供你审阅。

howto.what_en: Reads screen history from screenpipe, detects repeated workflows, matches them against existing skills, and drafts new skill docs or composition recipes, outputting proposals for review. Runs locally; only redacted summaries go to the LLM.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit user request to analyze recent work (e.g. last 4 hours / day / week) and propose skills, or to find uncovered workflows. Needs the local screenpipe daemon running; otherwise it refuses.

say_en.text: Analyze my last 4 hours of work and propose automatable skills.
say_en.note: It reads local screen history and generates a proposal.

say_en.text: Look at my repeated research flows this week; what's not covered yet?
say_en.note: It compares against existing skills and lists gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill based on my recent literature-search habits.
say_en.note: It generates a SKILL.md draft for review.
